text:
maya: quick idea — for GovCloud launch bakeoff, marketing wants a micro 'email snack' (single email + 1-pager + 3 benchmark bullets). can we get numbers + a one-line compliance hook? cc @aj @rachel
aj: on it. will pull the bakeoff numbers from last week's run. want raw p50/p95 + tokens/sec + est $/1M tokens?
rachel: absolutely. lead with FedRAMP + VPC + SLA in the first line. customers need 'data stays in-region' upfront.
ben_sales: add clear CTA: 'request GovCloud demo' -> routes to enterprise@redwood.com + sales form. include a checkbox for 'private deployment interest' so AEs can triage.
luis_eng: numbers from cluster run (summary):
- p50 generate (512 tokens): 180ms
- p95 generate (512 tokens): 480ms
- throughput: 220 tokens/s per GPU
- est cost: $125 / 1M tokens (quantized profile)
I'll paste the raw command shortly.
maya: perfect. can you add one short customer-friendly line linking these to latency SLAs? e.g., 'consistent p50 < 200ms helps interactive editors'
luis_eng: done. also add fallback note: 'automatic regional fallback to compatible model variants keeps apps live during regional strain' (one short sentence).
sara_marketing: I can draft the email. rough subject ideas:
- 'GovCloud-ready LLM inference — secure, fast, SLA-backed'
- 'Bring LLMs on your terms: GovCloud + SLAs'
Which tone? compliance-first or product-first?
maya: compliance-first for initial send, product-first follow-up.
sara_marketing: ok. draft landing in doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder (will update).
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: govcloud-bakeoff-figures v1 -> staging at 2025-06-18T15:12Z :rocket:
ben_sales: :thumbsup: also include a one-line "What customers ask" FAQ: 
- Do you support KMS/HSM? Yes.
- Can we run air-gapped? Yes — Private deployment.
- What's the SLA? 99.9% for Dedicated, custom for Private.
aj: I'll upload CSV of raw results to the doc. filename: gov-bakeoff-2025-06-17.csv
rachel: for the 1-pager, keep sections: TLDR, Key numbers (3 bullets), Compliance & networking, CTA. add one sentence under TLDR about bench methodology.
sara_marketing: working on 1-pager mock — will post PDF/PNG for field tomorrow. can someone approve copy by EOD?
maya: I can do a quick pass by 4pm PT.
luis_eng: FYI bench methodology (short): 3x runs, synthetic user patterns, models pinned to quantized-2 profile. example command (abbrev, include in appendix only):
```
./run_bench --region us-gov-west-1 --model rdx-3b-q2 --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --runs 3
```
sara_marketing: good call — will keep the command in an appendix, not frontline.
ben_sales: routing for inbound leads: CTA -> hubspot form 'govcloud-interest' + slack notif to #sales-enterprise with tags. sara, can you wire form fields?
sara_marketing: on it. form will include 'deploy_mode' checkbox: Hosted / Dedicated / Private and 'interest_level' picklist.
maya: thanks team. timeline: soft send to top 50 target accounts next Tue, broader drip Thurs. include UTM campaign tag govcloud_bakeoff_jun. call if blockers.
